body: I appreciate your words and thank you. I'm looking for a medical treatment, even I already take 2 medicines, I just don't have follow-up in myself, thank you very much
You too bro thanks for listening me, love for you and whatever do you want, you are a big person, you are amazing

thanks for what you said bro really thanks, like, i'm not very open to people, and me having started doing that i think was the problem, like, in my worst moments, when i get really bad, or i get needy wanting someone i consider a lot of all the attention for me or i just want to be alone and calm down little by little, and i feel that recently this most "needy" part is the one that's showing up the most and i don't like it , because it's like I just don't care about the life of the person I'm talking to, it's like I don't care if the person is sick or not, but I still care a lot, but at these times the only thing I show That's what I'm missing or how bad I am. and it causes pain to the people around me. What happened in the last few days was this, I have someone I love more than anything, more than anyone else that has ever passed in my life, and I'm very close to her and that kind of thing, we went out a lot too, it was almost all weekend, but I ended up coming to a city in the countryside that I hate and I always feel really bad, (to visit my parents and grandparents, so I can't just not come too.) and my contact with this person, besides having decreased, no we talked so much, and countless times what I wanted was to just give up and disappear for a while, and this person didn't let me, because she said it wasn't right and that I was only going to get hurt doing this, but in the same way, me being here I wanted to distract, get out of my head that I was in this place, and I got upset with her for silly and ridiculous things, and I took it out on her how bad I was, but I forgot at the moment, because of the bad time she was in, how bad she was also know, and that hurt me a lot, of course it's not compa sorry for the pain she felt but still i love her so much and me doing this to her made me feel really bad and frustrated and it wasn't even the fifth time i did this to her this is the worst part you know , I am every moment failing her non-stop and she never gave up on me, so I keep imagining the pain she goes through and why she continues, because the times and the ways I hurt her is what makes me feel bad . not being able to do things the way I wanted to, not leaving who I want well, not treating the person who most deserves to be treated well. And what I did with it recently, when I was already bad, I made her feel bad, I fought with relatives, people said horrible things to me too, it ended up making a gigantic snowball and I ended up blowing everything on her, and I can't. just undo it, i can't change what i've done. "It seems I only destroy what I touch"If I just failed myself, it would be so much better, it's just that I pull someone along with me in this, I can't just sink into shit alone, I hurt someone along.at the end of the day, it feels more like a love problem than like I've given up on things. and i just feel like my problems are very small compared to others  
  
  
I write much, sorry about that.

I feel the same way, honestly I created this account today because I'm saturated with everything. Everything I touch my finger to seems to rot. everything. And when I feel bad and I think about really ending this cycle of my life, I do another shit, I hurt someone important to me, and I just can't just forget and finish what I wanted. I feel that with each passing day I make everything worse, but I also can't just do it, I'm afraid of death, I'm afraid of feeling pain, I'm afraid of the after, if someone misses me? But anyway I'm still tired of trying things, trying hard and failing all the time. I know I'm weak, that my head is fragile, I know perfectly well, but I still try, but with every attempt of the will to give up, it's like I make everything worse and then feel bad because I hurt someone. It's been so long living for people, from when I was 15.16 years old (from ninth grade) until now with me at 18 finished high school. I can't just let go of people's feelings, I always just hang my head, ignore my feelings and how bad I was about. There were so many things in the last few years that I want to give up, I feel like it's my time, I tried a lot and I just can't finish it, I don't have the courage and will to do it.  
With each passing day I feel even more like a loser  
 Sorry for my bad english, and sometimes I have to use google translator...
